title: Practice 1: The present tense: the Е and И types

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The machine needs oiling.
exercises.why: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The following verbs belong to the "**Е**" type of conjugation: **думать** — **я думаю**, **ты думаешь** … **они думают**; **слушать**; **спрашивать**.

exercises.q: Том всегда ___ (держать) в багажнике своей машины комплект кабелей для «прикуривания».
exercises.prompt: Tom always keeps a set of jumper cables in the trunk of his car.
exercises.why: The verb **лежать** belongs to the "**И**" type of conjugation: **я лежу**, **ты лежишь** … **они лежат**. — From the DLI Grammar Reference Book, Lessons 16–18.  ·  Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
exercises.context: The verb **лежать** belongs to the "**И**" type of conjugation: **я лежу**, **ты лежишь** … **они лежат**.

exercises.q: Мэри заметила, как Том с Кончитой ___ (флиртовать).
